name: HRDecoder local-global private representation candidate
MAC_scope: analytic shapes, small-CPU Conv/Linear hooks checked; excludes original model and non-MAC operations, no GPU speed claim

initialization.original: same ImageNet HRNet-W48 initialization procedure and original HRDecoder head RNG as baseline
initialization.new_parameters: random, independent RNG; zero only final fusion output weight and bias

teacher.A: locked old D/E/B/E4 system including its existing H4
teacher.S: locked S_seed42 update20000 EMA DINOv3 spatial model
teacher.cache_status: complete train targets not found; export and preflight required
teacher.cache_coordinates: original image probability, shared student geometry

input.raw_rearrangement: PixelUnshuffle4, RGB3 to48 channels on512 grid
input.student_images_and_augmentation: same two image IDs and original baseline augmentation parameters per global batch

original_path.API_change: retain native F1-F4 before original concatenation; expose z0 and HR crop outputs/coordinates
original_path.decoder_operators: original LR/HR fusion and random HR crops

operators.P: 1x1 Conv no bias -> per-pixel ChannelLN eps1e-5 affine -> GELU
operators.Down: 3x3 stride2 Conv no bias -> ChannelLN -> GELU
operators.B_c_k_e: identity + DWConv k no bias -> ChannelLN -> 1x1 c to e*c no bias -> GELU -> 1x1 e*c to c no bias
operators.all_padding: same spatial size for odd-kernel stride1 convolutions

global_private_path.token_grid: same spatial shape as F4,32x32 on2048 canvas
global_private_path.position: fixed 2D sincos; each axis128 channels/64 frequency pairs; frequency10000^(-2i/128); integer grid positions
global_private_path.normalization: two pre-LN affine epsilon1e-5 per block

signed_readouts.target_outputs: PixelShuffle4 of each packed readout; four signed class differences, no sigmoid or tanh

fusion.restoration: resize final logits to original shape then sigmoid and strict>0.5

loss.KD_reduction: mean valid pixels per image/class, then mean valid image/classes
loss.signed_auxiliary: average U/S of per image/class sum[v*(1+4*abs(d))*SmoothL1(pred-d,beta0.1)] / sum[v*(1+4*abs(d))]
loss.empty_support: differentiable zero, exclude from valid image/class average
loss.routing_implementation: autograd.grad(lambdaD*aux,private_params,retain_graph=True); task.backward(); add auxiliary grads only to private params; one optimizer.step
loss.lambdaK: 0 through1500, ramp to0.5 at4000, hold through32000, decay to0.1 at40000

training.lr_policy: baseline polynomial power1 min_lr0 iteration convention

validity_and_protocol.valid: valid label AND independent geometric source support
